title: Auto Body
award: Certificate of Achievement requiring 16S/24Q to fewer than 30S/45Q units

outcomes: Apply critical thinking and problem solving skills in the process of diagnosing and repairing electrical and electronic systems, utilizing computer data bases and operating appropriate diagnostic equipment.
Safely work with power and hand tools, welding equipment, and chemicals in an auto body repair shop.
Apply critical thinking and problem solving skills in the process of following instructions and professional inter-personal communication with management and coworkers.
Demonstrate competence and familiarity working with various metals, techniques, and equipment, including practicing all standard safety procedures.

notes: The description says the certificate is awarded for 'a minimum of 25 units as outlined below', but the requirements table and 'Total Units Required for Certificate' both print 29.00. total_units records 29; a reviewer should check the conflict.
The catalog prints codes with a leading zero (AUTOB 010, AUTOB 020, AUTOB 012); these were matched to closed-list AUTOB 10, AUTOB 20 and AUTOB 12.

ATECH 023 (Automotive Air Conditioning, 4 units) is required in the catalog but is not in the closed list, so it is marked as a catalog addition. Without it the closed list totals 25 units, which matches the 25-unit figure in the description.
The careers list includes 'automotive collision and repair environments' from the Career Opportunities heading. This names a work environment rather than a job title.
The careers list includes 'technicians' and 'teachers' from the program description. 'Teachers' is named as a path through further study toward a baccalaureate degree.
